findings.problem: Both proofs show that a point with nonzero `orderAt` is in the range of `zeroPointEmbedding`. Each one (1) argues by contradiction using `orderAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem` to get `x.1 ∈ support`, (2) casts the support to a `Set X` with `change`, (3) rewrites with `range_subschemeι`, (4) destructs the preimage, and (5) closes with `Subtype.ext hy`. The block appears at lines 58–64 and again at lines 98–105, with only the final packaging differing (`⟨y, _⟩` versus `Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_univ y, _⟩`). The fiddly `change`/`rw [← range_subschemeι]` step has to be kept in sync in two places.
findings.proposed_change:
Add this after `zeroPointEmbedding`:

theorem mem_range_zeroPointEmbedding_of_orderAt_ne_zero
    (hDVR : ∀ x : X, x ≠ genericPoint X → IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (L : LineBundle X) (s : GlobalSections X L.sheaf) (hs : s ≠ 0) (x : CurvePoint X)
    (hx : orderAt hDVR L s x ≠ 0) : x ∈ Set.range (zeroPointEmbedding L s hs) := by
  have hmem : x.1 ∈ (SectionZeroIdeal.zeroIdeal L s).support := by
    by_contra hn
    exact hx (orderAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem hDVR L s x hn)
  change x.1 ∈ ((SectionZeroIdeal.zeroIdeal L s).support : Set X) at hmem
  rw [← (SectionZeroIdeal.zeroIdeal L s).range_subschemeι] at hmem
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩

Then `orderAt_finite_support` becomes: after the `Finite` instance, `apply (Set.finite_range (zeroPointEmbedding L s hs)).subset; intro x hx; exact mem_range_zeroPointEmbedding_of_orderAt_ne_zero hDVR L s hs x hx`. In `divisor_degree_eq_euler_difference`, `hDT` becomes: `intro x hx; have hn : orderAt hDVR L s x ≠ 0 := by simpa [D] using Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx; obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem_range_zeroPointEmbedding_of_orderAt_ne_zero hDVR L s hs x hn; exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_univ y, hy⟩`. This also removes the local `I` bookkeeping from `hDT`.
findings.benefit: The scheme-theoretic fact that the support of the divisor lies inside the zero scheme is proved once and named. Both theorems then read as short finiteness or summation arguments. Any change to how `support` and `subschemeι` interact is made in one place.
